name: Santé bottom bracket
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 295 g for the BB-5000 square-taper bottom-bracket set with 108 mm spindle. The brochure lists 68-W108 and 70-W108 sizes; the Shimano drawing confirms 108 mm spindles for both shell widths. The weighed thread/shell variant is not specified.
